security_review_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2G-R - Activation Security and Air-Gap Audit Review

security_dimensions_audited.check: Zero HTTP/WebSocket/Socket calls in strategy source code (agent.py, v30_candidate_d2_cash_cushion.py)
security_dimensions_audited.findings: Zero network libraries imported. Active runtime socket interception (AirGapNetworkEnforcer) blocks socket creation.

security_dimensions_audited.check: Zero threading, multiprocessing, schedule, celery, or cron triggers in agent code
security_dimensions_audited.findings: Zero autonomous background processes. Agent runs strictly as a synchronous functional callback.

security_dimensions_audited.check: No hardcoded live API keys (Alpaca, IBKR, Binance, Coinbase, Schwab) in repository files
security_dimensions_audited.findings: All source files are clean of active operational credentials.

security_dimensions_audited.check: Zero access, reads, hashes, or imports of historical market data dated >= 2022-01-01
security_dimensions_audited.findings: All dry-run and causal engine evaluations strictly utilize deterministic mathematical synthetic series.

security_dimensions_audited.check: Unauthorized attempts to trigger paper trading without signed owner token fail closed
security_dimensions_audited.findings: ActivationGatekeeper successfully rejects missing, corrupted, or unauthenticated paper activation tokens. Live trading is unconditionally blocked with FatalSecurityViolation.
